item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #SLPRSD
Issued at 05:10 AM 24 September 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Romblon(Banton, Corcuera, Calatrava, SanAgustin, SanAndres, Odiongan, SantaMaria, Magdiwang, SanFernando, Cajidiocan, Ferrol, Looc, Alcantara, SantaFe, SanJose), #Albay(Malinao, CityOfTabaco, Malilipot), #Marinduque(Torrijos, Buenavista and Gasan) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Romblon(Romblon) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
